semiconductor_relevance: High — CohPros International Co., Ltd is a distributor of various semiconductor-related equipment and materials, providing integrated services in the semiconductor industry.
summary: CohPros International Co., Ltd is a consulting distributor specializing in semiconductor bond testing, LED, solar, SMT, and laser equipment. They offer comprehensive sales, service, and maintenance support, aiming to deliver competitive products and solutions to their customers.

regional_presence.Taiwan: CohPros has established branches in HsinChu, Kaohsiung, and Taipei to provide prompt service support.
regional_presence.China: The company has a presence in Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, and Xi’an to enhance its sales and service capabilities.
